policy.scope: Current country; exact native book/entity/store/warehouse scope. Disabled countries retain authorized historical reads.
policy.field: Native current field policy remains authoritative; files, recipients and delegates cannot grant authority.

idem.binding: Native command UUID/body identity or explicit immutable state/source uniqueness; see service contract.

policy.facts: Server source-byte/canonical hash, immutable linked attempts, duplicate source claims, all-row validation and one transaction; native opening provenance and no invented cash/payment/GL.
